name: After-sales Procedure.xmind
text:
# Sheet: 画布 1
- After-sales Procedure
  - Describe what happened
    - When this problem occurred
    - What you did to adjust it like restart the device or change new accessories
    - How you use this device like connecting some IP cameras
  - Provide as many actual photos/videos as possible
    - This is direct and efficient to help figure out the problems.
  - Prepare necessary and relevant accessories such as SFP module/network cable/patch-cord...
    - With in-hand accessories, sometimes it is easy to fix the problem.
    - An example is, in a linear network connection, if one SFP module fails, the whole system might have a transmission problem.
The solution would be as simple as replacing a new workable SFP module.
  - Get ready for online meeting
    - A zoom video meeting link will be shared for face-to-face discussion
    - Remote control might be required via Teamviewer or Anydesk
